job.title: Chef de Partie
job.description:
Line Chef (Chef de Partie) – European Cuisine

Hastings, Hawke’s Bay
Contract / Ongoing
$36–$38 per hour + GST

We are seeking experienced Line Chefs (Chef de Partie) to join a new restaurant opening in Hastings, Hawke’s Bay.

The restaurant will specialise in European cuisine, with a strong focus on à la carte service, alongside functions and other busy service periods.

This role is suited to chefs who can step into a professional kitchen, quickly understand what is required and hit the ground running with minimal training and supervision.

About the Role:

You will work as part of an experienced kitchen team, taking responsibility for your designated section and supporting both restaurant and function service.
You will need to be confident working in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene and consistency.

What’s on Offer:
  • $36–$38 per hour
  • Contract / ongoing opportunities
  • European cuisine and à la carte service
  • Mix of restaurant and function work
  • Flexible shifts based on operational requirements
  • Opportunity for experienced chefs to step in and get straight to work
Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepare and cook European-style dishes to a high standard
  • Confidently manage your designated section during service
  • Deliver consistent, high-quality à la carte meals
  • Assist with preparation and service for functions and events
  • Maintain high standards of food quality and presentation
  • Follow food safety and hygiene requirements
  • Work efficiently during busy service periods
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe workstation
  • Work closely with the Head Chef and wider kitchen team
  • Quickly adapt to the restaurant’s menu and kitchen procedures
About You:

We are looking for experienced Chef de Partie / Line Chefs who:
  • Have previous commercial kitchen experience
  • Are confident working in an à la carte environment
  • Have experience with European cuisine or similar styles
  • Can confidently run a section independently
  • Require minimal training and supervision
  • Can quickly adapt to a new kitchen and menu
  • Work effectively under pressure during busy services
  • Are reliable and flexible with availability
  • Take pride in food quality, consistency and presentation
  • Have a professional and team-focused attitude
  • Have the legal right to work in New Zealand

Ready to Get Started?

If you are an experienced Chef de Partie / Line Chef who can walk into a kitchen, take ownership of your section and perform with minimal supervision, we want to hear from you, apply today.

job.title: Automotive Technician / WOF Inspector
job.description:
Staffing Agency, a national recruitment company, is seeking an experienced Automotive Technician / WOF Inspector for a well-established New Zealand-owned automotive service business in Cambridge.

If you hold current NZ WOF Inspector authority and have strong experience in vehicle servicing, diagnostics and mechanical repairs, this is an opportunity to join a professional workshop backed by more than 45 years of industry experience and over 40 service locations across New Zealand.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
  • Join an established New Zealand-owned automotive business with more than 45 years of industry experience
  • Work in a professional and supportive workshop environment
  • Enjoy a varied workload across cars, 4x4s, utes, vans and European vehicles
  • Gain exposure to EVs, hybrids and modern vehicle technologies
  • Work with a business focused on quality workmanship, customer safety and professional service
ABOUT THE ROLE

You will carry out Warrant of Fitness inspections, vehicle servicing, diagnostics and general mechanical repairs while ensuring vehicles meet required safety and roadworthiness standards.
Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Conduct WOF inspections in accordance with NZTA requirements and accurately document inspection outcomes
  • Complete general servicing, preventative maintenance and mechanical repairs
  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using appropriate diagnostic equipment
  • Inspect and repair brakes, suspension, exhaust systems, tyres, batteries and related components
  • Maintain accurate workshop records while following all health, safety and quality procedures
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
  • Qualified and experienced Automotive Mechanic / Automotive Technician
  • Current NZ WOF Inspector authority
  • Proven experience in WOF inspections, diagnostics and fault-finding
  • Strong practical knowledge of servicing, brakes, suspension and general mechanical repairs
  • Reliable, safety-conscious and able to deliver high-quality workmanship independently and as part of a team
Experience working with EVs, hybrids, European vehicles or 4x4s would be advantageous.

Interested candidates click on the “APPLY NOW” button and submit your full updated resume online. (Easily readable word doc is preferred) Make sure you provide correct mobile number and email address in order for us to contact you - Staffing Agency 9855

job.title: Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
Great Hours | Overtime Available | Travel Covered | Potential Ongoing Work

Looking for your next hands-on mechanical role?
Staffing agency is a national recruitment company. We’re seeking an experienced Mechanical Fitter to join one of our clients a busy mining project in Waihi. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys practical work, variety, and being part of a hardworking site team.

You won’t be stuck doing the same task every day. The role covers mechanical fitting, pipework, plumbing, pump installation, equipment assembly and general mechanical work across the site.

What’s in it for you?
  • 7:00am–5:00pm shifts
  • Plenty of hours and overtime available
  • Saturday half-day work available
  • Additional Sunday work may be available
  • Travel to Waihi covered for suitable candidates from Tauranga or Hamilton
  • Plastic welding training provided
  • Varied, hands-on work across a mining project
  • Work alongside an experienced site team
  • Potential for longer-term work for the right person
  • Opportunity to build additional industrial and site experience
Project Details
Location: Waihi, NZ
Hours: 7:00am–5:00pm
Saturday: Half-day required
Sunday: Work may be available
Overtime: Available
Ongoing Work: Potential for the right candidate

Candidates based in Tauranga or Hamilton are encouraged to apply, with company-covered travel to the Waihi site available for suitable candidates.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You’ll be involved in a range of mechanical and site work, including:
  • Threading and installing galvanised pipe
  • Plumbing and general pipework
  • Building and connecting pipe systems
  • Installing pumps and mechanical equipment
  • Mechanical fitting and assembly
  • Installing and securing mechanical components
  • Tightening and loosening bolts and fittings
  • Plastic welding
  • General mechanical and hands-on site work
  • Following all site health and safety procedures
Haven’t done plastic welding before? That’s fine.
Training can be provided on site for the right person.

What We’re Looking For:
We want an experienced fitter who is practical, reliable and willing to get stuck in.
Ideally, you’ll have experience with:
  • Mechanical fitting
  • Galvanised pipe threading
  • Plumbing or pipe installation
  • Pumps and mechanical equipment
  • Mechanical assembly and installation
  • Industrial, construction or mining environments
More importantly, you’ll bring a strong work ethic and a great attitude.
You’ll be someone who is:
  • Reliable and hardworking
  • Confident using tools and mechanical equipment
  • Physically capable of site work
  • Adaptable and willing to help across different tasks
  • Safety conscious
  • Comfortable working as part of a team
  • Willing to learn new skills
To Be Considered, You Must:
  • Have proven experience as a Mechanical Fitter
  • Have strong practical mechanical skills
  • Be comfortable working with pipework and mechanical equipment
  • Be reliable and physically capable
  • Have strong health and safety awareness
  • Have a positive, flexible attitude
  • Have been living and working in New Zealand for at least two years
  • Have the legal right to work in New Zealand

Ready to Get Started?

If you’re an experienced Mechanical Fitter looking for solid hours, overtime, varied work and the possibility of longer-term opportunities, apply today.
We’d like to hear from practical tradespeople who turn up, work hard and get the job done.

job.description:
Are you a reliable labourer who is comfortable working at heights and ready to start immediately?

We are looking for a Labourer with working at heights ticket to join a busy commercial construction project in Palmerston North. You’ll work alongside an experienced roofing team, assisting with roofing materials, tools and general site duties.

You do not need to be a qualified roofer. What matters most is that you’re physically fit, reliable, comfortable working from scaffolding and ready to get stuck in.

Hours & Duration:

Start: Immediate start
Hours: Starting at 7:00am, with finish times varying depending on the day’s workload and generally running up to approximately 6:00pm.

What’s In It for You:
  • Immediate start
  • Ongoing work opportunity
  • Good working hours with 7:00am starts
  • Opportunity to work on a busy commercial construction project
  • Work alongside experienced roofing professionals
  • Gain further commercial roofing and construction experience
  • Varied, hands-on work
  • Potential opportunities for further work for reliable performers
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assisting roofers on a commercial construction site
  • Working from scaffolding on 1–2 storey buildings
  • Carrying, handling and positioning roofing materials
  • Assisting with nailing, screwing and fastening materials
  • Passing tools and materials to the roofing team
  • General site labouring
  • Keeping work areas clean and tidy
  • Following instructions from roofers and site supervisors
  • Working safely at heights and around scaffolding
What We’re Looking For:

To be successful, you should:
  • Have previous working-at-heights experience
  • Be confident and comfortable working from scaffolding
  • Be physically fit and capable of manual labour
  • Have basic experience using hand tools

job.description:
Staffing Agency is a leading national recruitment company currently seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Day Porter to join our client’s Workplace Experience team in Ahuriri, Napier. 

About the Role:

A Day Porter in the Hawkes Bay office is a part-time, hands-on workplace support role focused on keeping the office clean, functional, stocked, and welcoming for employees and visitors. The role is designed for 2 working days per week and requires flexibility around office events and business needs.

Working Hours:

Flexible part-time or casual opportunity based on business needs.
Current shifts are Wednesdays, 8:00 am-12:00 pm, and Thursdays, 10:00 am-2:00 pm, with hours adjustable via client if needed. Applicants must be available to assist with events, workspace resets, and occasional short-notice requests. Additional hours may be available as required.

What’s in it for you:
  • Hourly Rate $28 per hour (depending on experience)
  • Flexible days of work (Wednesday and Thursdays)
  • No late nights or weekend work
  • Stable, long-term assignment
  • Supportive corporate working environment
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Exposure to corporate events

Key Responsibilities:

Pantry Operations & Food Program Support
  • Manage pantry areas, ensuring stock levels are maintained and supplies are consistently replenished.
  • Keep fridges, snack displays, coffee/tea stations, and kitchen equipment replenished and organised at all times.
  • Clean and disinfect mugs, glasses, kitchenware, and food storage containers.
  • Conduct regular expiry checks and ensure all items meet food safety standards.
  • Remove litter and rubbish from common areas and ensure waste is disposed of properly.
  • Unpack deliveries and assist with presenting catering where required.
  • Sanitize storage areas and maintain a pest-free environment.
  • Ensure stock rooms remain clean, organized, and well-labelled.
  • Support lunch service (set-up, replenishment, pack-down).
  • Use internal channels (Slack, chat, email) to communicate with client teams.
  • Gather and relay employee feedback to HQ.
  • Maintain food health, hygiene, and safety protocols at all times.
  • Provide active updates on the Site Brief for visibility and tracking.
Meeting Room Support
  • Set up and pack down meeting rooms, including adjusting furniture, AV equipment, and supplies.
  • Ensure meeting rooms are clean, organised, and stocked with essentials (whiteboard markers, HDMI cables, notepads, etc.).
  • Provide quick support for ad-hoc requests and last-minute setups.
Space Resetting & Light Cleaning
  • Reset and tidy shared spaces such as All Hands areas, breakout spaces, kitchens, and wellness rooms.
  • Wipe down surfaces, address spills, and restock daily consumables.
  • Rearrange furniture layouts for daily use or special events.
General Office Support
  • Assist with moving furniture, whiteboards, workstations, and event equipment.
  • Support ad-hoc tasks such as receiving and delivering packages, organising storage, and workplace tidy-ups.
  • Provide workstation setup support for new hires when needed.
  • Assist with periodic stocktakes across supplies, equipment, and consumables.
  • Assist with periodic stocktakes across supplies, equipment, and consumables.
Facilities Monitoring & Reporting
  • Conduct routine walkthroughs to identify cleanliness, maintenance, or safety issues.
  • Monitor common areas including kitchens, reception, and bathrooms for stock levels, cleanliness, and functionality.
  • Report facility concerns (lighting, HVAC, plumbing, equipment issues) to the Workplace Experience team or relevant vendors.
Event & Meals Support
  • Assist with setting up and packing down internal events, including AV, furniture, catering stations, and signage.
  • Provide on-the-day support such as replenishing items, clearing rubbish, and keeping the event area tidy.
  • Support post-event resets to return spaces to standard layout.
  • Support Boost Days and catering, including setup, service monitoring, and cleanup for breakfast and lunch programs.
  • Coordinate with vendors and help guide suppliers onsite.
  • Respond to ad-hoc workplace requests and assist with general office upkeep and physical tasks.
Stocktake & Consumables Management
  • Maintain stock levels of stationery, cleaning products, kitchen supplies, and general office consumables.
  • Track coffee, tea, milk, and pantry essentials daily.
  • Support event-specific stocktakes such as social drinks (alcoholic & non-alcoholic).
  • Assist with supply planning and ordering where required.
Local Culture Champion & Connector
  • Serve as the primary on-site advocate, translating local cultural and operational insights into actionable feedback for the Workplace Experience teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with People Experience and IT to deliver seamless, "first-line" support that enhances the daily employee experience.

Skills & Qualifications:
  • Experience in hospitality, pantry operations, or office support preferred.
  • Detail-focused and service-oriented.
  • Comfortable lifting and moving moderately heavy items (up to ~20 kg).
  • Proactive and able to spot and report issues early.
  • Good time management skills and ability to manage competing tasks.
  • A strong communicator who works professionally with employees, vendors, and support teams. Basic tech literacy (email, Slack, ticketing tools).
  • Friendly and approachable, helping create a warm, inclusive office atmosphere.
  • Collaborative, working closely with Workplace Experience, cleaners, and catering personnel.
  • Proven ability to cultivate and manage strategic partnerships with local stakeholders to drive community-aligned initiatives
  • Fluent in English (verbal and written), able to follow instructions accurately and communicate clearly in a fast-paced environment.
